name: Snowflake
description: AI data cloud platform enabling data sharing, analytics, and AI workloads across clouds.
notes: IPO September 2020 (NYSE: SNOW). One of ICONIQ's most prominent growth investments. FY2026 revenue ~$4.7B.

name: Figma
description: Browser-based collaborative design and prototyping platform used by product and design teams worldwide.
notes: IPO July 2025 (NYSE: FIG). Adobe acquisition blocked by regulators in 2023. ICONIQ was an early growth investor.

name: Canva
description: Visual communication and design platform with 240M+ monthly active users. ~$3B ARR as of 2025.
notes: Valued at $42B (Aug 2025). IPO expected H2 2026. ICONIQ participated in growth rounds.

name: Datadog
description: Cloud infrastructure monitoring, APM, log management, and security platform for DevOps and engineering teams.
notes: IPO September 2019 (NASDAQ: DDOG). Market cap ~$83B. ICONIQ Growth invested in Series D.

name: GitLab
description: All-in-one DevSecOps platform covering source control, CI/CD, security scanning, and project management.
notes: IPO October 2021 (NASDAQ: GTLB). FY2026 revenue ~$955M. ICONIQ led a major growth round pre-IPO.

name: ServiceTitan
description: End-to-end business management platform for home and commercial service contractors (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, etc.).
notes: IPO December 2024 (NASDAQ: TTAN). ICONIQ Growth led the Series H ($500M) in 2021.

name: Procore
description: Construction management platform connecting owners, general contractors, and subcontractors on a single system of record.
notes: IPO May 2021 (NYSE: PCOR). ICONIQ Growth invested in a pre-IPO growth round.

name: Airtable
description: Low-code platform combining spreadsheet flexibility with database power, enabling teams to build custom apps and workflows.
notes: Last valued at ~$11B (Series F, 2021). ICONIQ Growth participated in multiple rounds. IPO timeline unclear.

name: Miro
description: Online visual collaboration platform and digital whiteboard used by 80M+ users for workshops, planning, and design.
notes: Valued at $17.5B (Series C, 2022). ICONIQ Growth led the Series C. IPO candidate.

name: Sprinklr
description: Unified customer experience management platform covering social, marketing, sales, and service across 30+ digital channels.
notes: IPO June 2021 (NYSE: CXM). ICONIQ Growth was a major investor, backing the company through multiple rounds.

name: Adyen
description: Global financial technology platform processing payments for enterprise merchants including Meta, Spotify, and Microsoft.
notes: Listed on Euronext Amsterdam (AMS: ADYEN). Q1 2026 revenue €597M. ICONIQ held a pre-IPO stake.

name: Collibra
description: Data intelligence platform providing data catalog, governance, quality, and lineage capabilities for enterprise data teams.
notes: Unicorn; last valued at $3.3B (2021). ICONIQ Growth led the Series E. Strong enterprise customer base.
